origin.description: Each line is a vector of byte values, without the line ending.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Each line is a vector of byte values, without the line ending.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
lines <- read_lines_raw(I("ab\ncd"))
paste(paste(as.integer(lines[[1]]), collapse = ","), paste(as.integer(lines[[2]]), collapse = ","), sep = ";")

translation.description: Each line is a vector of byte values, without the line ending.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Each line is a vector of byte values, without the line ending.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
lines = read_lines_raw(I("ab\ncd"))
return ";".join(",".join(str(value) for value in line) for line in lines)
